why: The floor quests of the System, as data. Why data: the owner's brief gives ONE example quest ('Clear 5 rooms without taking magic damage') and asks for 'objectives per floor'; the objectives, their sizes and what they pay are balance numbers that will be tuned many times after the first play, so a datapack can change a row, add one or switch one off (weight 0) without a mod update. Each row is one quest template. kind is one of CLEAR_ROOMS, KILL_N, NO_DAMAGE_STRETCH, SPEED, SURVIVE_AMBUSH. The target of a quest on a floor of threat T is clamp(round(base + perFloor * T), min, max): rooms to clear, monsters to defeat, ambushers to defeat, or (for SPEED) seconds allowed on the floor. title is the English text, {n} and {t} stand for the target; the lang key message.nusmp.mega.system.quest.<id> takes over where a translation exists. noMagic fails the quest at the first magic damage the player takes. rewards.stats are the stats a success may pay (the roll picks one), rewards.points how many points, rewards.shadowCore whether a Shadow Core may be paid instead of a point.

quests.title: Clear {n} rooms without taking magic damage
quests.why: The brief's own example. It pays INT because clearing a room carefully under magical threat is the mind's work. A room counts after 40 ticks inside with no hostile alive in it.

quests.title: Clear {n} rooms of every hostile creature
quests.why: The plain clearing quest, a little easier than the no-magic one (no condition to break), so a party that fights with spells can still earn the clearing reward.

quests.title: Defeat {n} monsters on this floor
quests.why: The combat quest: strength or agility is what a fighter earns. The count grows half a monster per floor so a deep floor asks for a real fight.

quests.title: Defeat {n} monsters without taking magic damage
quests.why: The combat quest with the brief's magic condition: a little fewer monsters, in exchange for staying out of the spellcasters' reach.

quests.title: Reach the next floor without taking any damage
quests.why: Endurance by avoidance: any damage at all fails it, and it is judged when the staircase is taken. It is the hardest quest, so it pays two points of VIT.

quests.title: Reach the next floor within {t} seconds
quests.why: The race: seconds spent ON the quest's floor, shortening by two seconds per floor of depth down to two and a half minutes. It starts generous because nobody has played it yet.

quests.title: Survive the ambush: defeat {n} of the creatures that hunt you
quests.why: The Dungeon Master's ambush groups carry the entity tag nusmp_dm; defeating them is how a player proves their senses. Counts for every player of the party near the kill.
